en: The milestones with work in flight, the one the graph allows next, and the latest release as the releases themselves say it, read live on every call (ADR 0166, decision 4). Now is every open milestone holding an open issue with an open pull request that names it (`plan.delivery`'s `pr_open`), a live mesh claim made for it, or a declared ACTIVE status, each with those issues, why they are in flight, their declared status beside their inferred stage, and the objects that prove it (branch, pull request, merge commit, release tag, published `latest.json`, claim), linked on the forge where the forge has them. Next is the first open milestone in the plan's order that is not now and whose unfinished prerequisites are all now. The latest release is the highest stable version among the release records, the `v*` tags of this clone and the `latest.json` the last successful Pages deployment published, so a release whose record merged after its tag is not shown older than it is; `executable_tagged` says whether the answering executable's own version is tagged. `milestone` adds that milestone with every one of its issues. A source that was not read (the forge, the publication, the mesh outside a server) is named with its reason, never treated as empty.

en: ADR 0126 judges a caller by its address. The router already refuses a loopback request whose Host is neither an address nor localhost (rebound()), so only a tunnel that rewrites Host to localhost passes as local; that hole affects every mutation and belongs to runtime-trust. Read-only is what ADR 0126 already allows remotely and what every ChatGPT plan can call. Critique 2026-10-18: ADR 0126 admits every read beyond loopback without authentication, so authenticating a vendor reader is a new mechanism that needs its own ADR; this issue serves the intent's a-vendor-reads-and-never-writes, not a-reference-validates-everywhere, which it does nothing for. Sources: chatgpt-majordomus:c239#7, chatgpt-majordomus:c267#2, chatgpt-majordomus:c065#4.
cs: ADR 0126 posuzuje volajícího podle jeho adresy. Router už odmítá loopbackový požadavek, jehož Host není ani adresa, ani localhost (rebound()), takže jako lokální projde jen tunel, který přepíše Host na localhost; tato díra se týká každé mutace a patří do runtime-trust. Jen pro čtení je to, co ADR 0126 už vzdáleně povoluje a co může volat každý plán ChatGPT. Kritika z 18. 10. 2026: ADR 0126 připouští každé čtení zvenčí loopbacku bez autentizace, takže autentizace čtenáře od dodavatele je nový mechanismus, který potřebuje vlastní ADR; tento úkol slouží kritériu záměru a-vendor-reads-and-never-writes, ne a-reference-validates-everywhere, pro které nedělá nic.
